scope: Только четыре canonical G5 в G1 низовьев Двины; проверки G1/G5 fail-closed обязательны при импорте и активации.
authoring_policy: One category rule per exact scope/category. allowed_item_refs is limited to the matching 4a2 presence row item_ref plus its PF frequency-backed variants; category used_by never expands the pool.
weight_policy: Explicit candidate 1:1 is the editorial default required when both weights are NULL by world_base_materialization_table_requirements.md §8.1. It is not an empirical claim. Keep disclosure modes unchanged.

approval_request: 4a5: сверить 53 правила с 4a3 (режимы и веса 1:1); три open-only derived rules выводятся только из size_band large/bulky. No import/activation.

source_gap_marker_register.note: Merge может свести два source PR к одной derived presence/placement row; source IDs сохранены отдельно.

source_precedence: For these 56 no-source placement rows, modes and weights come from 4a3 by presence_pr_id; duplicate mode fields in the 4a4 presence pool are informational only. Only the three large/bulky derived rules override 4a3 to exposed-only 1/0.

modes and weights for 53 non-open-only rules
canonical G5→G4→G1 selector derivation and validation
